description: A modern residential front porch at dusk, photographed at a three-quarter angle. The home's exterior facade is constructed of white painted or lime-washed stone in irregular coursed masonry, giving a clean, organic texture. The solid front door is crafted from rich stained walnut or dark brown wood with raised panel detailing, fitted with a sleek matte black smart-lock deadbolt and lever handle. To the right of the door, a tall floor-to-ceiling black-framed multi-pane window reflects the surrounding trees in its glass. The porch floor is horizontal wood decking in warm medium-toned cedar or teak planks. Two low-slung outdoor lounge chairs in light gray woven fabric sit side by side, each with a rust-and-cream striped linen throw pillow. Between the chairs, a small square teak side table provides a surface. A warm amber glow washes outward from the wall between the door and the right window, illuminating the white stone surface in a soft halo and casting a gentle gradient of warmth onto the chairs below. The sky behind visible trees is a dusky blue-gray. The palette is warm neutral — white stone, warm wood door, gray chairs — with a rust accent from the striped pillows and a warm amber glow effect on the wall. Camera is positioned at standing eye-level in a three-quarter view of the porch corner, level pitch, showing the door, wall, window, and seating simultaneously.
